begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>Definitions\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype SACLabels =
    NicA | NicB | NicC | NicD
  | R | RM |  SC | EP
  | T | NTFN1 | NTFN2 | NTFN3<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition complete_AgentAuthGraph where
  "complete_AgentAuthGraph g \<equiv>
     g \<union> {(y,a,y) | a y. True}
       \<union> {(x,a,y) | x a y. (x,Control,y) \<in> g }
       \<union> {(x,a,y)|x a y. \<exists>z. (x,Control,z) \<in> g \<and> (z, Control,y) \<in> g} "<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>declare complete_AgentAuthGraph_def [simp]<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation partition_label where
  "partition_label l \<equiv> OrdinaryLabel l"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition SACGraph where
  "SACGraph \<equiv>
  { (partition_label R, Read,  partition_label NicB), (partition_label R, Write, partition_label NicB),
    (partition_label R, Read,  partition_label NicD), (partition_label R, Write, partition_label NicD),
    (partition_label SC, Read,  partition_label NicC), (partition_label SC, Write, partition_label NicC),

    (partition_label RM, Control, partition_label R),
    (partition_label RM, Control, partition_label NicA),
    (partition_label RM, Control, partition_label NicB),
    (partition_label RM, Control, partition_label NicD),
    (partition_label T, Notify, partition_label NTFN1),

    (partition_label SC, Receive, partition_label NTFN1),

  }"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>declare SACGraph_def [simp]<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition SACAuthGraph  where
